1.web: But now thus says Yahweh who created you, Jacob, and he who formed you, Israel: “Don’t be afraid, for I have redeemed you. I have called you by your name. You are mine.
1.asv: But now thus saith Jehovah that created thee, O Jacob, and he that formed thee, O Israel: Fear not, for I have redeemed thee; I have called thee by thy name, thou art mine.

2.web: When you pass through the waters, I will be with you; and through the rivers, they will not overflow you. When you walk through the fire, you will not be burned, and flame will not scorch you.
2.asv: When thou passest through the waters, I will be with thee; and through the rivers, they shall not overflow thee: when thou walkest through the fire, thou shalt not be burned, neither shall the flame kindle upon thee.

3.web: For I am Yahweh your God, the Holy One of Israel, your Savior. I have given Egypt as your ransom, Ethiopia and Seba in your place.
3.asv: For I am Jehovah thy God, the Holy One of Israel, thy Saviour; I have given Egypt as thy ransom, Ethiopia and Seba in thy stead.

4.web: Since you have been precious and honored in my sight, and I have loved you; therefore I will give people in your place, and nations instead of your life.
4.asv: Since thou hast been precious in my sight, and honorable, and I have loved thee; therefore will I give men in thy stead, and peoples instead of thy life.

5.web: Don’t be afraid; for I am with you. I will bring your seed from the east, and gather you from the west.
5.asv: Fear not; for I am with thee: I will bring thy seed from the east, and gather thee from the west;

6.web: I will tell the north, ‘Give them up!’ and tell the south, ‘Don’t hold them back! Bring my sons from far, and my daughters from the ends of the earth—
6.asv: I will say to the north, Give up; and to the south, Keep not back; bring my sons from far, and my daughters from the end of the earth;

7.web: everyone who is called by my name, and whom I have created for my glory, whom I have formed, yes, whom I have made.’”
7.asv: every one that is called by my name, and whom I have created for my glory, whom I have formed, yea, whom I have made.

8.web: Bring out the blind people who have eyes, and the deaf who have ears.
8.asv: Bring forth the blind people that have eyes, and the deaf that have ears.

9.web: Let all the nations be gathered together, and let the peoples be assembled. Who among them can declare this, and show us former things? Let them bring their witnesses, that they may be justified; or let them hear, and say, “That is true.”
9.asv: Let all the nations be gathered together, and let the peoples be assembled: who among them can declare this, and show us former things? let them bring their witnesses, that they may be justified; or let them hear, and say, It is truth.

10.web: “You are my witnesses,” says Yahweh, “With my servant whom I have chosen; that you may know and believe me, and understand that I am he. Before me there was no God formed, neither will there be after me.
10.asv: Ye are my witnesses, saith Jehovah, and my servant whom I have chosen; that ye may know and believe me, and understand that I am he: before me there was no God formed, neither shall there be after me.

11.web: I myself am Yahweh; and besides me there is no savior.
11.asv: I, even I, am Jehovah; and besides me there is no saviour.

12.web: I have declared, I have saved, and I have shown; and there was no strange god among you. Therefore you are my witnesses”, says Yahweh, “and I am God.
12.asv: I have declared, and I have saved, and I have showed; and there was no strange god among you: therefore ye are my witnesses, saith Jehovah, and I am God.

13.web: Yes, since the day was I am he; and there is no one who can deliver out of my hand. I will work, and who can hinder it?”
13.asv: Yea, since the day was I am he; and there is none that can deliver out of my hand: I will work, and who can hinder it?

14.web: Thus says Yahweh, your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel: “For your sake, I have sent to Babylon, and I will bring all of them down as fugitives, even the Chaldeans, in the ships of their rejoicing.
14.asv: Thus saith Jehovah, your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel: For your sake I have sent to Babylon, and I will bring down all of them as fugitives, even the Chaldeans, in the ships of their rejoicing.

15.web: I am Yahweh, your Holy One, the Creator of Israel, your King.”
15.asv: I am Jehovah, your Holy One, the Creator of Israel, your King.

16.web: Thus says Yahweh, who makes a way in the sea, and a path in the mighty waters;
16.asv: Thus saith Jehovah, who maketh a way in the sea, and a path in the mighty waters;

17.web: who brings out the chariot and horse, the army and the mighty man (they lie down together, they shall not rise; they are extinct, they are quenched like a wick):
17.asv: who bringeth forth the chariot and horse, the army and the mighty man (they lie down together, they shall not rise; they are extinct, they are quenched as a wick):

18.web: “Don’t remember the former things, and don’t consider the things of old.
18.asv: Remember ye not the former things, neither consider the things of old.

19.web: Behold, I will do a new thing. It springs out now. Don’t you know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert.
19.asv: Behold, I will do a new thing; now shall it spring forth; shall ye not know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert.

20.web: The animals of the field shall honor me, the jackals and the ostriches; because I give water in the wilderness and rivers in the desert, to give drink to my people, my chosen,
20.asv: The beasts of the field shall honor me, the jackals and the ostriches; because I give waters in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert, to give drink to my people, my chosen,

21.web: the people which I formed for myself, that they might declare my praise.
21.asv: the people which I formed for myself, that they might set forth my praise.

22.web: Yet you have not called on me, Jacob; but you have been weary of me, Israel.
22.asv: Yet thou hast not called upon me, O Jacob; but thou hast been weary of me, O Israel.

23.web: You have not brought me of your sheep for burnt offerings; neither have you honored me with your sacrifices. I have not burdened you with offerings, nor wearied you with frankincense.
23.asv: Thou hast not brought me of thy sheep for burnt-offerings; neither hast thou honored me with thy sacrifices. I have not burdened thee with offerings, nor wearied thee with frankincense.

24.web: You have bought me no sweet cane with money, nor have you filled me with the fat of your sacrifices; but you have burdened me with your sins. You have wearied me with your iniquities.
24.asv: Thou hast bought me no sweet cane with money, neither hast thou filled me with the fat of thy sacrifices; but thou hast burdened me with thy sins, thou hast wearied me with thine iniquities.

25.web: I, even I, am he who blots out your transgressions for my own sake; and I will not remember your sins.
25.asv: I, even I, am he that blotteth out thy transgressions for mine own sake; and I will not remember thy sins.

26.web: Put me in remembrance. Let us plead together. Declare your case, that you may be justified.
26.asv: Put me in remembrance; let us plead together: set thou forth thy cause, that thou mayest be justified.

27.web: Your first father sinned, and your teachers have transgressed against me.
27.asv: Thy first father sinned, and thy teachers have transgressed against me.

28.web: Therefore I will profane the princes of the sanctuary; and I will make Jacob a curse, and Israel an insult.”
28.asv: Therefore I will profane the princes of the sanctuary; and I will make Jacob a curse, and Israel a reviling.
